title: Handoff event
description: An event in the handoff protocol between Creator and Host. Events form a chain tracked by run and digest.

candidate_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the candidate being handed off.

source_actor.description: Actor initiating this handoff. Cannot be same as target_actor.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence supporting this handoff.

allowed_next_actions.description: Actions the target actor may take after this event.

attempt.description: Attempt number for this handoff chain.

parent_event_id.description: ID of the parent event in the handoff chain, if any.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate processing of this event.
